DEV.2026.008 – No temperature data log for stability samples during transit from Marfleet Analytical Services Ltd, Hull (contracted stability storage facility) to Eaststone Ltd, Bolton (manufacturer and testing site).
The deviation resulted from a combination of Human Error, Procedural Gaps relating to off-site transportation requirements and pre-dispatch verification and inadequate oversight during shipment coordination. 
Corrective action: Pre-dispatch check list and post-dispatch check list to reinforce requirements for data logger verification.
Preventative actions: Update procedure ES.SOP.218 to define 
•	Off-site stability sample handling.
•	Transport conditions.
•	Mandatory data logger uses and verification.
•	Pre-dispatch checklist.
•	Requirements of transport provider.
